meta.title: Kilnberry: a Lovable site moved to WordPress
meta.author: Flow Lab
meta.description: Demo. The five-page Kilnberry Clay Studio site rebuilt as a WordPress theme with editor blocks, English and Russian (Polylang), day and night theme. Kilnberry Clay Studio is a fictional business.

steps.code: <?php define( 'WP_ADMIN', true ); require '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; delete_transient( 'pll_languages_list' ); $m = PLL()->model; if ( method_exists( $m, 'clean_languages_cache' ) ) { $m->clean_languages_cache(); } if ( isset( $m->languages ) && method_exists( $m->languages, 'clean_cache' ) ) { $m->languages->clean_cache(); } foreach ( pll_languages_list( array( 'fields' => '' ) ) as $l ) { echo $l->slug, ' front ', $l->page_on_front, PHP_EOL; }
